WeddingTime.Text: at three o'clock in the afternoon

IntroText.Text: Please join us to celebrate the wedding of

ReceptionNote.Text: Dinner, dancing, and celebration into the night

LeadText.Text: Your presence at our celebration is the most meaningful gift we could receive.

BodyText.Text: If you would like to give us a gift, we would be truly grateful for a monetary contribution towards our future together.

Milestone1Description.Text: A chance encounter that neither of us expected, but one that changed everything.

Milestone5Description.Text: The day we say "I do" surrounded by the people we love most.

Milestone3Description.Text: Building a home together and learning what it truly means to be a team.

Milestone4Description.Text: A question asked, a joyful yes, and the beginning of forever.

Milestone2Description.Text: We discovered that the best journeys are the ones shared with someone special.

Tradition3Description.Text: The bride tosses her bouquet to unmarried women, and the one who catches it is said to be the next to marry.

Tradition5Description.Text: The couple cuts the wedding cake together, hand over hand, symbolizing their first shared act as husband and wife.

Tradition4Description.Text: When guests clink and tap in unison, the newlyweds must kiss. The louder the clinking, the longer the kiss.

IntroText.Text: A glimpse into the customs that make a Hungarian wedding truly unforgettable

Tradition1Description.Text: Guests queue to dance with the bride for a brief moment, each placing money into a basket to wish the couple prosperity.

Tradition2Description.Text: Friends playfully "kidnap" the bride, and the groom must complete humorous tasks or pay a ransom to win her back.

IntroText.Text: More details about the day will follow in due course.

DetailsText.Text: Information regarding accommodation, transport, and the evening programme will be shared closer to the date.
